notes.title: update 2022/11/29
notes.content: Fixed a bug that caused it to no longer be playable after 30 minutes.
The new version optimizes the data caching feature.

notes.title: Good News
notes.content: The Apple Edition of Classic Chess is grandly released today, and Apple Fans are welcome to taste and give valuable advice. At the same time, the problem that the window version of "Classic Chess" cannot be started normally in some computer environments has also been completely fixed, and I apologize for the inconvenience caused to everyone!
The macOS version of the game is live!
